import uuid

def list_client_feedback_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[ClientFeedback], int]:
    query = db.query(ClientFeedback).filter(ClientFeedback.deleted_at.is_(None))
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(ClientFeedback.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return list(items), total


def create_client_feedback_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ClientFeedbackCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> ClientFeedback:
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    feedback_id = next_business_id(db, "FB", year)

    feedback = ClientFeedback(
        feedback_id=feedback_id,
        date=data.date,
        client_id=data.client_id,
        reference_type=data.reference_type,
        reference_id=data.reference_id,
        overall_rating=data.overall_rating,
        quality_rating=data.quality_rating,
        timeliness_rating=data.timeliness_rating,
        communication_rating=data.communication_rating,
        would_recommend=data.would_recommend,
        comments=data.comments,
    )
    db.add(feedback)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(feedback)
    return feedback


def get_client_feedback_service(db: Session, feedback_id: uuid.UUID) -> ClientFeedback | None:
    return (
        db.query(ClientFeedback)
        .filter(ClientFeedback.id == feedback_id, ClientFeedback.deleted_at.is_(None))
        .first()
    )


def update_client_feedback_service(
    db: Session,
    feedback_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: ClientFeedbackUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> ClientFeedback | None:
    feedback = get_client_feedback_service(db, feedback_id)
    if not feedback:
        return None

    if data.feedback_id is not None:
        feedback.feedback_id = data.feedback_id
    if data.date is not None:
        feedback.date = data.date
    if data.client_id is not None:
        feedback.client_id = data.client_id
    if data.reference_type is not None:

    if data.timeliness_rating is not None:

    if data.communication_rating is not None:

    if data.would_recommend is not None:
        feedback.would_recommend = data.would_recommend
    if data.comments is not None:

    db.refresh(feedback)
    return feedback


def delete_client_feedback_service(

) -> bool:
